payload.description:
## Context
When the native probe ran on Claude Code 2.1.322 for basicly-s3yqg13, the shipped catalog let git push -d origin branch, git push origin -d branch and git push origin +main run. The first two delete a remote branch, so the remote-delete guardrail has a gap; a + refspec is a force push, so the force-push guardrail has a gap. Candidates seen quiet in that probe: Bash(git *push* -d *) and Bash(git *push* +*); the effect of the second on other commands was not probed. The permissions.yaml comment at lines 30 to 31 still cites the 2.1.312 probe and should name 2.1.322.
